The problem with most tools isn't that they lack features—it's that they have too many. Every notification, every unnecessary button, every complex workflow pulls your team away from what matters: building great products. We believe the best tools are invisible. readmeSignals.title: GitHub Stacked PRs
readmeSignals.summary: A GitHub CLI extension for managing stacked branches and pull requests. Stacked PRs break large changes into a chain of small, reviewable pull requests that build on each other. gh stack automates the tedious parts — creating branches, keeping them rebased, setting correct PR base branches, and navigating between layers. Requires the https://cli.github.com/ gh v2.0+. Install the gh-stack skill so your AI coding agent knows how to work with stacked PRs and the gh stack CLI: A stack is an ordered list of branches where each branch builds on the one below it. The bottom of the stack is based on a trunk branch typically main.

readmeSignals.title: Speech To Speech: Build voice agents with open-source models
readmeSignals.summary: Speech To Speech: Build voice agents with open-source models A low-latency, fully modular voice-agent pipeline: VAD - STT - LLM - TTS, exposed through an OpenAI Realtime-compatible WebSocket API. Every component is swappable. The LLM slot speaks OpenAI-compatible protocols, so you can point it at a hosted provider, at https://huggingface.co/inference-providers, or at a vLLM or llama.cpp server on your own hardware for a fully local, fully open stack. This pipeline runs in production as the conversation backend for thousands of https://huggingface.co/blog/reachy-mini robots.

metadata.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.

readmeSignals.title: ============ Configuration Parameters ============
readmeSignals.summary: -highlights · overview · core-technology-reject-flat-storage-embrace-layering-and-symbolization · -features · quick-start TencentDB Agent Memory = symbolic short-term memory + layered long-term memory. - Symbolic short-term memory offloads heavy tool logs and condenses them into compact Mermaid symbols, cutting token usage and improving task success. - Layered long-term memory distills fragmented conversations into structured personas and scenes, instead of flat vector piles. When integrated with OpenClaw, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, improves pass rate by 51.52% relative, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%.
headings: Core Technology: Reject Flat Storage, Embrace Layering and Symbolization
1. Memory Layering: Progressive Disclosure with Heterogeneous Storage
2. Symbolic Memory: Maximum Semantics in Minimum Symbols (Mermaid Canvas)
